description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Repeat.
